WITH n, targets, reduce(found = [kept, 0], step IN range(1, size(targets)) | CASE WHEN found[1] = size(found[0]) THEN found ELSE [found[0] + [t IN targets WHERE NOT t IN found[0] AND any(h IN [(h)-[:WORKS_FOR]->(t) | h] WHERE h IN found[0][found[1]..])], size(found[0])] END)[0] AS kept

FALKORDB.PersonCareer.delete.orphans:
MATCH (n:Person)
WHERE n.uuid = $id
WITH n
WITH n, [c1 IN [(n)-[:WORKS_FOR]->(c1) | c1] WHERE c1:Organization] AS targets
WITH n, reduce(seen = [], t IN targets | CASE WHEN t IN seen OR t = n THEN seen ELSE seen + t END) AS targets
WITH n, targets, [t IN targets WHERE any(m IN [(t)--(m) | m] WHERE m <> n AND NOT m IN targets)] AS kept
WITH n, targets, reduce(found = [kept, 0], step IN range(1, size(targets)) | CASE WHEN found[1] = size(found[0]) THEN found ELSE [found[0] + [t IN targets WHERE NOT t IN found[0] AND any(h IN [(h)-[:WORKS_FOR]->(t) | h] WHERE h IN found[0][found[1]..])], size(found[0])] END)[0] AS kept
WITH n, [t IN targets WHERE NOT t IN kept] AS orphans
DETACH DELETE n
WITH orphans
FOREACH (t IN orphans | DETACH DELETE t)
RETURN count(*) + sum(size(orphans)) AS deleted

WITH n, reduce(seen = [], t IN targets | CASE WHEN t IN seen OR t = n THEN seen ELSE seen + t END) AS targets
WITH n, targets, [t IN targets WHERE any(m IN [(t)--(m) | m] WHERE m <> n AND NOT m IN targets)] AS kept
WITH n, targets, reduce(found = [kept, 0], step IN range(1, size(targets)) | CASE WHEN found[1] = size(found[0]) THEN found ELSE [found[0] + [t IN targets WHERE NOT t IN found[0] AND any(h IN [(h)-[:HAS_LOCATION]->(t) | h] WHERE h IN found[0][found[1]..])], size(found[0])] END)[0] AS kept
WITH n, [t IN targets WHERE NOT t IN kept] AS orphans
DETACH DELETE n
WITH orphans
FOREACH (t IN orphans | DETACH DELETE t)
RETURN count(*) + sum(size(orphans)) AS deleted

FALKORDB.schema.listFullTexts: CALL db.indexes() YIELD label, properties, types, entitytype WHERE entitytype = 'NODE' RETURN {label: label, properties: properties, types: types}
FALKORDB.schema.dropRange:
DROP INDEX FOR (n:Session) ON (n.lastActivityAt)
DROP INDEX FOR (n:Session) ON (n.sessionId)
FALKORDB.schema.createVector: CREATE VECTOR INDEX FOR (n:Chunk) ON (n.embedding) OPTIONS {dimension: 1536, similarityFunction: 'cosine', M: 32, efConstruction: 200, efRuntime: 10}
FALKORDB.schema.createVector.plain: CREATE VECTOR INDEX FOR (n:Chunk) ON (n.summary) OPTIONS {dimension: 384, similarityFunction: 'euclidean'}
FALKORDB.schema.createFullText: CREATE FULLTEXT INDEX FOR (n:Article) ON (n.title, n.body)
FALKORDB.schema.dropFullText:
DROP FULLTEXT INDEX FOR (n:Article) ON (n.title)
DROP FULLTEXT INDEX FOR (n:Article) ON (n.body)
FALKORDB.schema.dropFullText.named:
DROP FULLTEXT INDEX FOR (n:Article) ON (n.title)
DROP FULLTEXT INDEX FOR (n:Article) ON (n.body)
FALKORDB.schema.conflicts: MATCH (n:Person) WHERE n.email IS NOT NULL AND n.tenant IS NOT NULL WITH n.email AS _k0, n.tenant AS _k1, count(*) AS holders, collect({elementId: id(n)}) AS held WHERE holders > 1 RETURN {properties: {email: _k0, tenant: _k1}, count: holders, nodes: held[0..10]} LIMIT 10
FALKORDB.schema.conflicts.nodeId: MATCH (n:Person) WHERE n.email IS NOT NULL AND n.tenant IS NOT NULL WITH n.email AS _k0, n.tenant AS _k1, count(*) AS holders, collect({elementId: id(n), uuid: n.uuid}) AS held WHERE holders > 1 RETURN {properties: {email: _k0, tenant: _k1}, count: holders, nodes: held[0..10]} LIMIT 10

ORACLE.schema.lowerCopies.read: SELECT label AS "label", properties AS "properties" FROM drivine_schema WHERE kind = 'LOWER_COPY'
ORACLE.schema.listRanges: SELECT JSON_OBJECT('label' VALUE c.label, 'properties' VALUE JSON(c.properties), 'name' VALUE c.name, 'details' VALUE c.details, 'incomplete' VALUE CASE WHEN c.kind = 'RANGE_INDEX' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_indexes l WHERE l.index_name = UPPER(JSON_VALUE(c.details, '$.labelled'))) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM drivine_schema u WHERE u.label = c.label AND u.properties = c.properties AND u.kind IN ('UNIQUENESS_CONSTRAINT', 'UNIQUE') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_indexes q WHERE q.index_name = UPPER(u.object_name))) THEN 'true' END RETURNING JSON) AS "item" FROM drivine_schema c WHERE c.kind IN ('RANGE_INDEX', 'RANGE') AND (c.object_name IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_indexes i WHERE i.index_name = UPPER(c.object_name)) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_tables t WHERE t.table_name = UPPER(c.object_name))) ORDER BY c.label, c.properties
ORACLE.schema.listUniques: SELECT JSON_OBJECT('label' VALUE c.label, 'properties' VALUE JSON(c.properties), 'name' VALUE c.name, 'details' VALUE c.details, 'incomplete' VALUE CASE WHEN c.kind = 'RANGE_INDEX' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_indexes l WHERE l.index_name = UPPER(JSON_VALUE(c.details, '$.labelled'))) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM drivine_schema u WHERE u.label = c.label AND u.properties = c.properties AND u.kind IN ('UNIQUENESS_CONSTRAINT', 'UNIQUE') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_indexes q WHERE q.index_name = UPPER(u.object_name))) THEN 'true' END RETURNING JSON) AS "item" FROM drivine_schema c WHERE c.kind IN ('UNIQUENESS_CONSTRAINT', 'UNIQUE') AND (c.object_name IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_indexes i WHERE i.index_name = UPPER(c.object_name)) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_tables t WHERE t.table_name = UPPER(c.object_name))) ORDER BY c.label, c.properties

ORACLE.schema.conflicts: SELECT JSON_OBJECT('properties' VALUE JSON_OBJECT('email' VALUE k0, 'tenant' VALUE k1), 'count' VALUE MAX(c), 'nodes' VALUE JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('elementId' VALUE nid) ORDER BY nid RETURNING JSON) RETURNING JSON) AS "value" FROM (SELECT n.nid, JSON_VALUE(n.props, '$."email"') AS k0, JSON_VALUE(n.props, '$."tenant"') AS k1, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY JSON_VALUE(n.props, '$."email"'), JSON_VALUE(n.props, '$."tenant"')) AS c, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY JSON_VALUE(n.props, '$."email"'), JSON_VALUE(n.props, '$."tenant"') ORDER BY n.nid) AS r FROM drivine_node n WHERE JSON_EXISTS(n.labels, '$?(@ == "Person")') AND JSON_VALUE(n.props, '$."email"') IS NOT NULL AND JSON_VALUE(n.props, '$."tenant"') IS NOT NULL) WHERE c > 1 AND r <= 10 GROUP BY k0, k1 FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY

FROM (

    FROM (SELECT DISTINCT n_.nid, (n_.props -> 'released') AS k0 FROM drivine_node n_ WHERE n_.labels @> '["Movie"]') m

) g
LEFT JOIN drivine_node k0_ ON k0_.nid = g.k0r
ORDER BY ROW(CASE jsonb_typeof((k0_.props -> 'released')) WHEN 'string' THEN '""'::jsonb WHEN 'object' THEN CASE WHEN ((k0_.props -> 'released') ->> '$t') IS NOT NULL THEN jsonb_build_object('k', CASE ((k0_.props -> 'released') ->> '$t') WHEN 'datetime' THEN 1 WHEN 'localdatetime' THEN 2 WHEN 'date' THEN 3 WHEN 'time' THEN 4 WHEN 'localtime' THEN 5 WHEN 'duration' THEN 6 ELSE 0 END, 's', COALESCE((k0_.props -> 'released') -> 's', (k0_.props -> 'released') -> 'v')) ELSE (k0_.props -> 'released') END WHEN 'array' THEN CAST(drivine_list_key((k0_.props -> 'released')) AS jsonb) ELSE NULLIF((k0_.props -> 'released'), 'null'::jsonb) END, (CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof((k0_.props -> 'released')) = 'string' THEN (k0_.props ->> 'released') END) COLLATE "C")

    FROM (SELECT DISTINCT n_.nid, (n_.props -> 'released') AS k0 FROM drivine_node n_ WHERE n_.labels @> '["Movie"]' AND (n.released > $from)) m

POSTGRES.Person.matching:
SELECT jsonb_build_object('value', jsonb_build_object('props', n_.props || jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object('__drivine.stamp', n_.stamp)), 'labels', n_.labels), 'score', s.score) AS "result"
FROM (SELECT b.nid, b.labels, b.props, b.stamp, b.score / MAX(b.score) OVER () AS score
FROM (
    SELECT w.nid, w.labels, w.props, w.stamp, CAST(ln(1 + (w.n - w.df1 + 0.5) / (w.df1 + 0.5)) * w.tf1 * 2.2 / (w.tf1 + 1.2 * (0.25 + 0.75 * w.len / NULLIF(w.avglen, 0)))
        + ln(1 + (w.n - w.df2 + 0.5) / (w.df2 + 0.5)) * w.tf2 * 2.2 / (w.tf2 + 1.2 * (0.25 + 0.75 * w.len / NULLIF(w.avglen, 0))) AS double precision) AS score
    FROM (
        SELECT h.*, (
            SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS double precision)
            FROM (
                SELECT length(COALESCE(COALESCE((c.props -> 'name') ->> 'v', (c.props ->> 'name')), '') || ' ' || COALESCE(COALESCE((c.props -> 'bio') ->> 'v', (c.props ->> 'bio')), '')) AS len
                FROM drivine_node c
                WHERE c.labels @> '["Person"]'
            ) l) AS n, (
            SELECT CAST(AVG(l.len) AS double precision)
            FROM (
                SELECT length(COALESCE(COALESCE((c.props -> 'name') ->> 'v', (c.props ->> 'name')), '') || ' ' || COALESCE(COALESCE((c.props -> 'bio') ->> 'v', (c.props ->> 'bio')), '')) AS len
                FROM drivine_node c
                WHERE c.labels @> '["Person"]'
            ) l) AS avglen, SUM(CASE WHEN h.tf1 > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER () AS df1, SUM(CASE WHEN h.tf2 > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER () AS df2
        FROM (
            SELECT s.nid, s.labels, s.props, s.stamp, s.len, (SELECT count(*) FROM regexp_matches(s.text, CAST($_cy_ft1 AS text), 'g')) AS tf1, (SELECT count(*) FROM regexp_matches(s.text, CAST($_cy_ft2 AS text), 'g')) AS tf2
            FROM (
                SELECT c.nid, c.labels, c.props, c.stamp, lower(COALESCE(COALESCE((c.props -> 'name') ->> 'v', (c.props ->> 'name')), '') || ' ' || COALESCE(COALESCE((c.props -> 'bio') ->> 'v', (c.props ->> 'bio')), '')) AS text, length(COALESCE(COALESCE((c.props -> 'name') ->> 'v', (c.props ->> 'name')), '') || ' ' || COALESCE(COALESCE((c.props -> 'bio') ->> 'v', (c.props ->> 'bio')), '')) AS len
                FROM drivine_node c
                WHERE c.labels @> '["Person"]'
            ) s
            WHERE (s.text ~ CAST($_cy_ft3 AS text) OR s.text ~ CAST($_cy_ft4 AS text))
        ) h
    ) w
) b
WHERE b.score > 0) s JOIN drivine_node n_ ON n_.nid = s.nid
WHERE n_.labels @> '["Person"]'
ORDER BY s.score DESC, n_.nid
FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY

FROM (SELECT b.nid, b.labels, b.props, b.stamp, b.score / MAX(b.score) OVER () AS score
FROM (

    FROM (

            ) l) AS avglen, SUM(CASE WHEN h.tf1 > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER () AS df1, SUM(CASE WHEN h.tf2 > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER () AS df2
        FROM (

SELECT json_object('root', json(json_object('props', json_patch(n_.props, json_object('__drivine.stamp', n_.stamp)), 'labels', json(n_.labels))), 'rels', json(json_object('friends', json((SELECT json_group_array(json(json_object('props', json_patch(x2.props, json_object('__drivine.stamp', x2.stamp)), 'labels', json(x2.labels)))) FROM drivine_edge e1 JOIN drivine_node x2 ON x2.nid = e1.dst
WHERE e1.src = n_.nid AND e1.type = 'KNOWS' AND instr(x2.labels, '"Account"') > 0))))) AS "result"
FROM drivine_node n_
WHERE instr(n_.labels, '"Account"') > 0 AND ((((COALESCE(n_.props ->> '$."__drivine.lower.email"."$t"', CASE json_type(n_.props, '$."__drivine.lower.email"') WHEN 'integer' THEN 'number' WHEN 'real' THEN 'number' WHEN 'true' THEN 'boolean' WHEN 'false' THEN 'boolean' WHEN 'null' THEN NULL ELSE json_type(n_.props, '$."__drivine.lower.email"') END) = COALESCE(NULLIF(json_quote(drivine_lower(CASE WHEN json_type($_cy__q0) = 'text' THEN $_cy__q0 ->> '$' END)), 'null') ->> '$."$t"', CASE json_type(NULLIF(json_quote(drivine_lower(CASE WHEN json_type($_cy__q0) = 'text' THEN $_cy__q0 ->> '$' END)), 'null'), '$') WHEN 'integer' THEN 'number' WHEN 'real' THEN 'number' WHEN 'true' THEN 'boolean' WHEN 'false' THEN 'boolean' WHEN 'null' THEN NULL ELSE json_type(NULLIF(json_quote(drivine_lower(CASE WHEN json_type($_cy__q0) = 'text' THEN $_cy__q0 ->> '$' END)), 'null'), '$') END) AND COALESCE(n_.props ->> '$."__drivine.lower.email".s', n_.props ->> '$."__drivine.lower.email".v', n_.props ->> '$."__drivine.lower.email"') = COALESCE(NULLIF(json_quote(drivine_lower(CASE WHEN json_type($_cy__q0) = 'text' THEN $_cy__q0 ->> '$' END)), 'null') ->> '$.s', NULLIF(json_quote(drivine_lower(CASE WHEN json_type($_cy__q0) = 'text' THEN $_cy__q0 ->> '$' END)), 'null') ->> '$.v', NULLIF(json_quote(drivine_lower(CASE WHEN json_type($_cy__q0) = 'text' THEN $_cy__q0 ->> '$' END)), 'null') ->> '$') AND CASE WHEN NOT COALESCE(json_type((n_.props -> '$."__drivine.lower.email"')), 'null') = 'null' AND NOT COALESCE(json_type(NULLIF(json_quote(drivine_lower(CASE WHEN json_type($_cy__q0) = 'text' THEN $_cy__q0 ->> '$' END)), 'null')), 'null') = 'null' THEN drivine_equal((n_.props -> '$."__drivine.lower.email"'), NULLIF(json_quote(drivine_lower(CASE WHEN json_type($_cy__q0) = 'text' THEN $_cy__q0 ->> '$' END)), 'null')) END) AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM drivine_node n1
    JOIN drivine_edge e2 ON TRUE
    WHERE instr(n1.labels, '"Account"') > 0
      AND e2.src = n_.nid AND e2.dst = n1.nid
      AND e2.type = 'KNOWS'
      AND CASE WHEN NOT COALESCE(json_type(NULLIF(json_quote(drivine_lower(CASE WHEN json_type((n1.props -> '$."email"')) = 'text' THEN (n1.props -> '$."email"') ->> '$' END)), 'null')), 'null') = 'null' THEN (json_type(NULLIF(json_quote(drivine_lower(CASE WHEN json_type((n1.props -> '$."email"')) = 'text' THEN (n1.props -> '$."email"') ->> '$' END)), 'null')) = 'text' AND (NULLIF(json_quote(drivine_lower(CASE WHEN json_type((n1.props -> '$."email"')) = 'text' THEN (n1.props -> '$."email"') ->> '$' END)), 'null') ->> '$') = ($_cy__q1 ->> '$')) END
))))
SQLITE.groups.byProperty:
/* drivine:json */
SELECT json_object('k0', json(g.k0), 'a0', json(g.a0)) AS "row"
FROM (
    SELECT m.k0, COUNT(*) AS a0, MIN(n_.nid) AS k0r
    FROM (SELECT DISTINCT n_.nid, (n_.props -> '$."released"') AS k0 FROM drivine_node n_ WHERE instr(n_.labels, '"Movie"') > 0) m
    JOIN drivine_node n_ ON n_.nid = m.nid
    GROUP BY m.k0
) g
LEFT JOIN drivine_node k0_ ON k0_.nid = g.k0r
ORDER BY CASE json_type((k0_.props -> '$."released"')) WHEN 'object' THEN CASE ((k0_.props -> '$."released"') ->> '$."$t"') WHEN 'datetime' THEN '2~1' || COALESCE(((k0_.props -> '$."released"') ->> '$.s'), ((k0_.props -> '$."released"') ->> '$.v')) WHEN 'localdatetime' THEN '2~2' || COALESCE(((k0_.props -> '$."released"') ->> '$.s'), ((k0_.props -> '$."released"') ->> '$.v')) WHEN 'date' THEN '2~3' || COALESCE(((k0_.props -> '$."released"') ->> '$.s'), ((k0_.props -> '$."released"') ->> '$.v')) WHEN 'time' THEN '2~4' || COALESCE(((k0_.props -> '$."released"') ->> '$.s'), ((k0_.props -> '$."released"') ->> '$.v')) WHEN 'localtime' THEN '2~5' || COALESCE(((k0_.props -> '$."released"') ->> '$.s'), ((k0_.props -> '$."released"') ->> '$.v')) WHEN 'duration' THEN '2~6' || COALESCE(((k0_.props -> '$."released"') ->> '$.s'), ((k0_.props -> '$."released"') ->> '$.v')) ELSE '1' END WHEN 'array' THEN '2!' || drivine_sort_key((k0_.props -> '$."released"')) WHEN 'text' THEN '3' WHEN 'true' THEN '4' WHEN 'false' THEN '4' WHEN 'integer' THEN '5' WHEN 'real' THEN '5' END NULLS LAST, ((k0_.props -> '$."released"') ->> '$') NULLS LAST

FROM (
    SELECT m.k0, COUNT(*) AS a0, SUM(CASE WHEN n.released < 2000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS a1, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN n.released > 2000 THEN (CASE WHEN json_type((n_.props -> '$."released"')) IN ('integer', 'real') THEN (n_.props -> '$."released"') ->> '$' END) END), 0) AS a2, AVG((CASE WHEN json_type((n_.props -> '$."released"')) IN ('integer', 'real') THEN (n_.props -> '$."released"') ->> '$' END)) AS a3, (json_group_array(n_.nid ORDER BY CASE json_type((n_.props -> '$."released"')) WHEN 'object' THEN CASE ((n_.props -> '$."released"') ->> '$."$t"') WHEN 'datetime' THEN '2~1' || COALESCE(((n_.props -> '$."released"') ->> '$.s'), ((n_.props -> '$."released"') ->> '$.v')) WHEN 'localdatetime' THEN '2~2' || COALESCE(((n_.props -> '$."released"') ->> '$.s'), ((n_.props -> '$."released"') ->> '$.v')) WHEN 'date' THEN '2~3' || COALESCE(((n_.props -> '$."released"') ->> '$.s'), ((n_.props -> '$."released"') ->> '$.v')) WHEN 'time' THEN '2~4' || COALESCE(((n_.props -> '$."released"') ->> '$.s'), ((n_.props -> '$."released"') ->> '$.v')) WHEN 'localtime' THEN '2~5' || COALESCE(((n_.props -> '$."released"') ->> '$.s'), ((n_.props -> '$."released"') ->> '$.v')) WHEN 'duration' THEN '2~6' || COALESCE(((n_.props -> '$."released"') ->> '$.s'), ((n_.props -> '$."released"') ->> '$.v')) ELSE '1' END WHEN 'array' THEN '2!' || drivine_sort_key((n_.props -> '$."released"')) WHEN 'text' THEN '3' WHEN 'true' THEN '4' WHEN 'false' THEN '4' WHEN 'integer' THEN '5' WHEN 'real' THEN '5' END DESC NULLS FIRST, ((n_.props -> '$."released"') ->> '$') DESC NULLS FIRST) FILTER (WHERE (NOT COALESCE(json_type((n_.props -> '$."released"')), 'null') = 'null'))) ->> '$[0]' AS a4, MIN(n_.nid) AS k0r
    FROM (SELECT DISTINCT n_.nid, (n_.props -> '$."released"') AS k0 FROM drivine_node n_ WHERE instr(n_.labels, '"Movie"') > 0 AND (n.released > $from)) m
    JOIN drivine_node n_ ON n_.nid = m.nid

) g
LEFT JOIN drivine_node k0_ ON k0_.nid = g.k0r
LEFT JOIN drivine_node a4_ ON a4_.nid = g.a4
ORDER BY g.a0 DESC NULLS FIRST, CASE json_type((k0_.props -> '$."released"')) WHEN 'object' THEN CASE ((k0_.props -> '$."released"') ->> '$."$t"') WHEN 'datetime' THEN '2~1' || COALESCE(((k0_.props -> '$."released"') ->> '$.s'), ((k0_.props -> '$."released"') ->> '$.v')) WHEN 'localdatetime' THEN '2~2' || COALESCE(((k0_.props -> '$."released"') ->> '$.s'), ((k0_.props -> '$."released"') ->> '$.v')) WHEN 'date' THEN '2~3' || COALESCE(((k0_.props -> '$."released"') ->> '$.s'), ((k0_.props -> '$."released"') ->> '$.v')) WHEN 'time' THEN '2~4' || COALESCE(((k0_.props -> '$."released"') ->> '$.s'), ((k0_.props -> '$."released"') ->> '$.v')) WHEN 'localtime' THEN '2~5' || COALESCE(((k0_.props -> '$."released"') ->> '$.s'), ((k0_.props -> '$."released"') ->> '$.v')) WHEN 'duration' THEN '2~6' || COALESCE(((k0_.props -> '$."released"') ->> '$.s'), ((k0_.props -> '$."released"') ->> '$.v')) ELSE '1' END WHEN 'array' THEN '2!' || drivine_sort_key((k0_.props -> '$."released"')) WHEN 'text' THEN '3' WHEN 'true' THEN '4' WHEN 'false' THEN '4' WHEN 'integer' THEN '5' WHEN 'real' THEN '5' END NULLS LAST, ((k0_.props -> '$."released"') ->> '$') NULLS LAST

SQLITE.Person.nearest:
/* drivine:json */
SELECT json_object('value', json(json_object('props', json_patch(n_.props, json_object('__drivine.stamp', n_.stamp)), 'labels', json(n_.labels))), 'score', s.score) AS "result"
FROM (SELECT k.nid, k.score FROM (SELECT c.nid, drivine_similarity((c.props -> '$."embedding"'), $_vector, 'COSINE') AS score FROM drivine_node c WHERE instr(c.labels, '"Person"') > 0 AND json_type(c.props, '$."embedding"') = 'array') k WHERE k.score IS NOT NULL ORDER BY k.score DESC, k.nid LIMIT 5) s JOIN drivine_node n_ ON n_.nid = s.nid
WHERE instr(n_.labels, '"Person"') > 0
ORDER BY s.score DESC, n_.nid

SQLITE.Person.matching:
/* drivine:json */
SELECT json_object('value', json(json_object('props', json_patch(n_.props, json_object('__drivine.stamp', n_.stamp)), 'labels', json(n_.labels))), 'score', s.score) AS "result"
FROM (SELECT b.nid, b.labels, b.props, b.stamp, b.score / MAX(b.score) OVER () AS score
FROM (
    SELECT w.nid, w.labels, w.props, w.stamp, CAST(drivine_math('log', 1 + (w.n - w.df1 + 0.5) / (w.df1 + 0.5)) * w.tf1 * 2.2 / (w.tf1 + 1.2 * (0.25 + 0.75 * w.len / NULLIF(w.avglen, 0)))
        + drivine_math('log', 1 + (w.n - w.df2 + 0.5) / (w.df2 + 0.5)) * w.tf2 * 2.2 / (w.tf2 + 1.2 * (0.25 + 0.75 * w.len / NULLIF(w.avglen, 0))) AS REAL) AS score
    FROM (
        SELECT h.*, (
            SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL)
            FROM (
                SELECT length(COALESCE(COALESCE(c.props ->> '$."name".v', (CASE json_type(c.props, '$."name"') WHEN 'text' THEN c.props ->> '$."name"' WHEN 'null' THEN NULL ELSE c.props -> '$."name"' END)), '') || ' ' || COALESCE(COALESCE(c.props ->> '$."bio".v', (CASE json_type(c.props, '$."bio"') WHEN 'text' THEN c.props ->> '$."bio"' WHEN 'null' THEN NULL ELSE c.props -> '$."bio"' END)), '')) AS len
                FROM drivine_node c
                WHERE instr(c.labels, '"Person"') > 0
            ) l) AS n, (
            SELECT CAST(AVG(l.len) AS REAL)
            FROM (
                SELECT length(COALESCE(COALESCE(c.props ->> '$."name".v', (CASE json_type(c.props, '$."name"') WHEN 'text' THEN c.props ->> '$."name"' WHEN 'null' THEN NULL ELSE c.props -> '$."name"' END)), '') || ' ' || COALESCE(COALESCE(c.props ->> '$."bio".v', (CASE json_type(c.props, '$."bio"') WHEN 'text' THEN c.props ->> '$."bio"' WHEN 'null' THEN NULL ELSE c.props -> '$."bio"' END)), '')) AS len
                FROM drivine_node c
                WHERE instr(c.labels, '"Person"') > 0
            ) l) AS avglen, SUM(CASE WHEN h.tf1 > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER () AS df1, SUM(CASE WHEN h.tf2 > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER () AS df2
        FROM (
            SELECT s.nid, s.labels, s.props, s.stamp, s.len, drivine_regexp_count(s.text, CAST($_cy_ft1 AS TEXT)) AS tf1, drivine_regexp_count(s.text, CAST($_cy_ft2 AS TEXT)) AS tf2
            FROM (
                SELECT c.nid, c.labels, c.props, c.stamp, drivine_lower(COALESCE(COALESCE(c.props ->> '$."name".v', (CASE json_type(c.props, '$."name"') WHEN 'text' THEN c.props ->> '$."name"' WHEN 'null' THEN NULL ELSE c.props -> '$."name"' END)), '') || ' ' || COALESCE(COALESCE(c.props ->> '$."bio".v', (CASE json_type(c.props, '$."bio"') WHEN 'text' THEN c.props ->> '$."bio"' WHEN 'null' THEN NULL ELSE c.props -> '$."bio"' END)), '')) AS text, length(COALESCE(COALESCE(c.props ->> '$."name".v', (CASE json_type(c.props, '$."name"') WHEN 'text' THEN c.props ->> '$."name"' WHEN 'null' THEN NULL ELSE c.props -> '$."name"' END)), '') || ' ' || COALESCE(COALESCE(c.props ->> '$."bio".v', (CASE json_type(c.props, '$."bio"') WHEN 'text' THEN c.props ->> '$."bio"' WHEN 'null' THEN NULL ELSE c.props -> '$."bio"' END)), '')) AS len
                FROM drivine_node c
                WHERE instr(c.labels, '"Person"') > 0
            ) s
            WHERE (drivine_regexp_count(s.text, CAST($_cy_ft3 AS TEXT)) > 0 OR drivine_regexp_count(s.text, CAST($_cy_ft4 AS TEXT)) > 0)
        ) h
    ) w
) b
WHERE b.score > 0) s JOIN drivine_node n_ ON n_.nid = s.nid
WHERE instr(n_.labels, '"Person"') > 0
ORDER BY s.score DESC, n_.nid
LIMIT 10
